issues.explanation: The first adaptation says姜维撤军“退回汉中,” whereas the source has him retreat into剑阁 and then屯于钟堤, the exact location where Chapter 111 begins. This creates a minor but concrete location/timeline mismatch at the handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the ending to say姜维退入剑阁，随后退屯钟堤（or simply退到钟堤），so Chapter 111 follows directly.
